# Denis Tsoi - Software Engineer & Developer

## Professional Summary
Denis Tsoi is the CTO at preferrd.io, with a strong background in frontend development and fintech. He previously served as a Staff Engineer, Frontend at Mox Bank (Standard Chartered's digital bank), demonstrating expertise in modern banking technology solutions.

## Career Journey
Denis made a successful career transition from being a senior dealer at a precious metals brokerage to becoming a full-time, full-stack web developer. This career pivot was driven by his passion for technology, a decision he has never regretted. He's a General Assembly Alumni, having completed the first Front-End Web Development course based in Hong Kong.

## Notable Achievements
- **Stack Overflow Contributor**: 11+ years of active participation with 10,442 reputation points, reaching 941k people with contributions
- **Community Involvement**: Active member of Think.HK and Hong Kong Web Dev Group
- **Educational Background**: Completed Udacity Full Stack Web Developer program in 2020

## Professional Philosophy
Denis focuses on "working on the difficult and challenging problems," indicating his preference for complex technical challenges and innovative solutions.

Based in Hong Kong SAR with 500+ professional connections and 2K+ followers, Denis is well-connected within the regional tech community.

Denis represents the modern software engineer who combines technical expertise with business acumen, having successfully transitioned between industries while maintaining a commitment to continuous learning and community contribution.
